title: Promega MagaZorb® DNA Mini-Prep Kit Automation
author: Opentrons (verified)
materials: Elution solution is added to the samples.
Beads are resuspended in elution solution.

steps.title: Load labware and set parameters
steps.instruction: Load the OT‑2 deck with the specified deep‑well plate, reservoir, tip rack, and elution plate; set the number of samples (1‑96, divisible by 8), starting sample volume (µL), binding‑buffer volume (µL), elution volume (µL), tip‑parking option, and mount the P300 multi‑channel pipette on the chosen left or right side.

steps.title: Mix binding buffer
steps.instruction: Mix the binding buffer by pipetting up and down five times.

steps.title: Add binding buffer to samples
steps.instruction: Dispense the specified binding‑buffer volume into each sample well of the deep‑well plate on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Engage magnet and incubate
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and incubate the plate for 7 minutes to allow bead binding.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant from each well and dispense it into the liquid‑waste container, then discard the tips (or park them per setting).

steps.title: First wash and resuspend
steps.instruction: Add the first wash buffer to each well, then mix to resuspend the beads.

steps.title: Remove first wash supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate the wash supernatant and discard into the liquid‑waste container.

steps.title: Second wash and remove
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash step with the second wash buffer, mix, then remove the supernatant to waste.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate on the magnetic module for 1 minute to air‑dry the beads.

steps.title: Add elution solution
steps.instruction: Dispense the specified elution volume into each well.

steps.title: Resuspend beads in elution
steps.instruction: Mix the elution solution to resuspend the beads thoroughly.

steps.title: Incubate elution
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 5 minutes to allow DNA elution.

steps.title: Engage magnet for elution
steps.instruction: Re‑engage the magnetic module and incubate for 7 minutes (variable settling time) to separate beads from eluate.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared eluate from each well to the corresponding well of the elution plate located in Slot 1.
